{{Top|leg}}
A '''microlab''' was a handheld portable [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] used by [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] for quickly analyzing materials in the field, when acquiring a full analysis from another location would take too long. A sample of the material to be examined would be placed in a small tube that was then slid into the device; then, the operator would perform any necessary adjustments to the device to conduct the examination, after which the results would be displayed on a small screen. Microlabs worked well enough to answer most questions, and in some cases, it would provide results that were just as good as a full examination.<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
